title_en: Cooking Chinese Dishes (11/20): Yangzhou Fried Rice
note_en: 除了…还… means "besides…, also…": 除了米饭和鸡蛋，这道菜还要放火腿、虾仁 "besides rice and eggs, this dish also takes ham and shrimp." English can put "besides" almost anywhere, but in Chinese the 除了 phrase comes first and 还 must sit right before the verb in the second half. If you mean "except," swap 还 for 都: 除了X，都… "everything except X."
